mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.0% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or correlation between FEDFUNDS and returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting Federal Reserve rate hikes that depress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In CPIAUCSL y/y > 3.5% periods, 20-day returns are positive in >55% of cases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment below 4.0% and strong employment growth (PAYEMS m/m > 0.5%) indicates labor market overheating, increasing rate hike probability and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In UNRATE < 4.0% AND PAYEMS m/m > 0.5% periods, 20-day returns are positive in >55% of cases, or interaction term regression coefficient is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer demand regime (RSAFS m/m > 1.0% and HOUST m/m > 0.5%) signals economic overheating, triggering Federal Reserve tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In RSAFS m/m > 1.0% AND HOUST m/m > 0.5% periods, 20-day returns are positive in >55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) reflects robust economic activity, boosting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor of 5-day returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or correlation between INDPRO and returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals economic weakness, prompting Federal Reserve rate cuts that support equity valuations and produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In UNRATE > 4.5% periods, 20-day returns are negative in >55% of cases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high housing starts (HOUST > 1300.0) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL y/y > 3.5%) indicate inflationary housing boom, increasing rate hike expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In HOUST > 1300.0 AND CPIAUCSL y/y > 3.5% periods, 20-day returns are positive in >55% of cases, or interaction term regression coefficient is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate above 4.5% indicates restrictive monetary policy, suppressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In FEDFUNDS > 4.5% periods, 60-day returns are positive in >55% of cases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.
